name: Call to Arms
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Your strength is evident, adventurer. Now to see how you fare against a real enemy.

The Boulderfists have a lair to the southwest of here towards the dwarven bridge, and, if I'm not mistaken, the maulers and magi there shall present to you a greater challenge--they have done so to us thus far.

Slay as many as you can and come to me in body when you are successful, or come to me in spirit when you fail. I shall give praise to your tenacity in battle either way.
narrative.objectives: Kill 10 Boulderfist Brutes and 4 Boulderfist Magi, and return to Drum Fel in the Hammerfall outpost.
narrative.offerRewardText: You are as strong as a kodo, and your lust for battle does your people proud.
narrative.requestItemsText: You hesitate. Why? You have shown great strength thus far, adventurer. Do not fail me now.

chain.subtitle: 5 quests from level 32 to 40, 15,000 XP in all.

quests.name: The Hammer May Fall
quests.objectiveText: Kill 8 Boulderfist Ogres and 10 Boulderfist Enforcers, then find Drum Fel in the Hammerfall outpost in Arathi Highlands.

quests.name: Call to Arms
quests.objectiveText: Slay 10 Witherbark Axe Throwers, 10 Headhunters and 8 Witch Doctors, and return to Drum Fel in the Hammerfall outpost.

quests.name: Call to Arms
quests.objectiveText: Kill 10 Boulderfist Brutes and 4 Boulderfist Magi, and return to Drum Fel in the Hammerfall outpost.

quests.name: Call to Arms
quests.objectiveText: Kill 7 Boulderfist Shaman and 3 Boulderfist Lords and return to Drum Fel in the Hammerfall outpost.

quests.name: The Real Threat
quests.objectiveText: Slay Or'Kalar and bring his Head to Korin Fel in the Hammerfall outpost.
